claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-042
Date of Incident: July 25, 2020
Time of Incident: Approximately 0200 hours
Location: 7900 block of Adams Avenue, Anaheim, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer P. Whitfield
Badge Number: 5189
Officer(s): Officer P. Whitfield, Multiple units
On July 25, 2020, at approximately 0200 hours, officers responded to a 911 call reporting a person with a firearm in the area of the 7900 block of Adams Avenue, Anaheim.
The caller reported hearing a gunshot.
Officers established a perimeter and used a public address system to broadcast announcements in both English and Spanish for the subject to exit and surrender.
claims.evidence_observations: At 00:56, an officer states 'Units, he's coming over the fence', indicating a perimeter is being established and announcements are being made.

claims.claim_text: The subject was eventually located fleeing on foot northbound from the residence.
Officers pursued on foot.
claims.evidence_observations: At 00:56, an officer states 'he's coming over the fence', indicating officers are pursuing the subject on foot.

claims.claim_text: The subject scaled a wall and ran through adjacent properties.
claims.evidence_observations: At 00:56, an officer states 'he's coming over the fence', indicating the subject scaled a wall.

claims.claim_text: During the pursuit, officers maintained verbal commands for the subject to stop and show his hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers issuing verbal commands for the subject to stop and show his hands.

claims.claim_text: The subject was cornered in a dark area near the rear of a building.
Officers ordered the subject to get on the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: At 01:03, an officer states 'Let me see your hands', indicating the subject was ordered to get on the ground.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not immediately comply.
claims.evidence_observations: At 01:03, an officer states 'Let me see your hands', indicating the subject did not immediately comply.

claims.claim_text: An officer fired three rounds when the subject made a threatening movement.
The subject fell to the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: At 01:03, an officer states 'Let me see your hands', indicating the subject fell to the ground.

claims.claim_text: Officers approached and began rendering medical aid.
The subject sustained gunshot wounds and was transported to the hospital.
No firearm was recovered from the subject's immediate possession.
A firearm was located in the area consistent with the initial 911 call about shots fired.
Body-worn camera footage was collected as evidence.
claims.evidence_observations: Body-worn camera footage is being recorded, as indicated by the 'AXON BODY 3' label and timestamp in the video.

claims.claim_text: Scene secured for investigation.
claims.evidence_observations: The video clip shows officers securing the area, indicating the scene was secured for investigation.
